metadata.title: Where the crypto came from: academic origins of PKI and PQC

notes: Ported from bubble-map university-IP + academia-abroad, crypto/PQC slice only (biometrics/adtech branches left in the other map). Ties the deployed standards back to the labs and people that produced them - and forward to the CRQC that threatens the classical ones.

entities.name: Caltech
entities.notes: Robert McEliece (Caltech/JPL) proposed the code-based McEliece cryptosystem (1978) - ~47 years unbroken, a leading conservative PQC candidate.

entities.name: Brown_University
entities.notes: Hoffstein, Pipher, Silverman built NTRU (1996) - the first practical lattice-based public-key scheme and a direct ancestor of today's lattice PQC.

entities.name: TU_Darmstadt
entities.notes: Buchmann/Dahmen/Huelsing built XMSS (eXtended Merkle Signature Scheme) - stateful hash-based signatures, the most conservative PQC signatures (RFC 8391).

entities.name: Tel_Aviv_University
entities.notes: Oded Regev (TAU/NYU) introduced Learning With Errors (LWE, 2005) - the hardness assumption underpinning the NIST lattice standards.

entities.name: Max_Planck
entities.notes: Max Planck Institute for Security & Privacy (Peter Schwabe) co-authored CRYSTALS-Kyber/Dilithium (ML-KEM/ML-DSA). With Radboud + Ru Bochum, the European academic core of PQC standardization.

entities.name: University_of_Waterloo
entities.notes: Institute for Quantum Computing + Centre for Applied Cryptographic Research (Menezes et al.; ECC/PQC). A historic crypto powerhouse whose co-op pipeline feeds Big Tech; with Perimeter Institute anchors Canada's quantum sector.

entities.name: USTC
entities.notes: University of Science and Technology of China (Jian-Wei Pan). Leads China's quantum program: Micius quantum-comms satellite, Jiuzhang photonic, Zuchongzhi superconducting. Central to state quantum + AI strategy (CAS).

entities.name: McEliece_Cryptosystem
entities.notes: Code-based crypto - a main PQC family (Classic McEliece; HQC), the conservative non-lattice branch. Long keys but decades of cryptanalysis behind it.

entities.name: NTRU
entities.notes: First practical lattice cryptosystem. IP passed NTRU Cryptosystems -> Security Innovation -> OnBoard Security -> Qualcomm (2019). NIST PQC round-3 finalist and conceptual precursor to ML-KEM/ML-DSA.

entities.name: XMSS
entities.notes: Hash-based stateful signatures (RFC 8391). With LMS, the hash-only-assumption branch that became SLH-DSA (FIPS 205). Deployed by the Quantum Resistant Ledger.

entities.name: LWE
entities.notes: Learning With Errors / Module-LWE - the mathematical basis of ML-KEM (Kyber) and ML-DSA (Dilithium), the primary NIST PQC standards.

edges.notes: Quantum-advantage demos, not a CRQC. Capability edge, not a break.
